# Paul and Silas Praying in Prison (Acts 16:25)

## Emotional Focus
Praying and praising even in hard places.

## Key KJV
“And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God.” (Acts 16:25)

## Gentle Retelling
Paul and Silas were in prison but they prayed and sang to God. An earthquake came and their chains fell off — God answered their prayers.

## Coloring Prompt
Paul and Silas sitting in prison singing with happy faces.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Even in hard times we can pray and praise God.”
